how_to: Translate each value of `items` to Thai following references/translation-rules.md. Write done_012.json with the SAME keys: {"items": {key: thai}}. List values stay lists.

items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.berserk.descr: Massively empower your body and infuse it with a flame aura. Allows you to go into a risky but overwhelmingly powerful berserker mode.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.berserker.des: Feed on your enemies' defeat. Gain EP from kills, destroy equipment faster, and boost your physical stats based on your power level.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.bewilder.desc: Manipulate friends and foes, compelling them to act according to your will.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.black_flame.d: Command the tempest infused flames to spew out black flames at your enemies or even shoot deadly fireballs and hell flares.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.black_lightni: Shoot black lightning at varying strength, or summon a massive storm which attacks any non-allied mobs. A short range plasma blast can also be used to melt even the strongest of foes.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.blizzard.desc: Creates a powerful storm of ice to slow your enemies and turn the tides of battle.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.blood_mist.de: Spill your own blood to summon a mist which steals the vitality of your enemies and can be blown up to harm any nearby entities or shoot a powerful blood beam.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.body_armor.de: Protect yourself from harm by summoning armorsaurus scales around your body.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.body_double.d: Use a tenth of your magical power to summon an identical clone which takes increased damage but will fight for you until the end. The user can exchange places with the clone but risk taking increased damage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.burden.descri: Shoot energy projectiles that increase the target's gravity.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chain_explosi: Summon a sequence of explosion that detonates in a chain around targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chant_annulme: Become able to cast mastered magic instantly, in water or even under the effects of silence.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.charm.descrip: Use your inherent power to turn your opponents neutral or to temporarily dominate weak opponents.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chef.descript: Purify and renew. Remove all negative effects and restore vitality to those under your care.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.chosen_one.de: Radiate authority and charisma to force fear into the hearts of your enemies and to make them follow you instead, while empowering yourself and your allies.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.coercion.desc: Shoot a blast of roar in front of you scaring any afflicted entities.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.cold_resistan: Ignore weak cold damage or resist the damage of powerful attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.commander.des: Lead the charge with your allies. Empower yourself and your allies to give yourself an overwhelming advantage.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.confusion.des: Apply vision confusion to surrounding targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.cook.descript: Bend reality to ensure your enemies meet their demise by ignoring their dodge and barriers.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.corrosion.des: Empower your attacks with the deadly effect of Corrosion, toggleable when mastered.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.corrosion_res: Ignore weak corrosive effects or reduce the damage from stronger corrosive attacks.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.create_greate: Call forth armed undead from the ground to aid the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.create_lesser: Call forth weak undead from the ground to aid the caster.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.creator.descr: Create any Unique Skill and use it for a limited amount of time.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.curse.descrip: Release Miasmic Mist to curse targets.
items.lang|tensura|tensura.skill.curse_bind.de: Call forth spirits of the death to bind and corrode targets.
